```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
```

```{r data and helpers}
source("scripts/main-data.R")
source("scripts/helpers.R")
```

```{r s1: all 1304 significant genes}

# holy shit. never run clustering directly in ComplexHeatmap ever again.
# always cluster the matrix beforehand and plot as-is.
# much easier to save and pull matrices if ever needed.

# get clustered matrix for 936 upreg genes
up_hm = readRDS("data/heatmap_up_936.rds")
up_mat = up_hm@ht_list[["log2fold"]]@matrix
up_order = ComplexHeatmap::row_order(up_hm)
up_mat_ordered = up_mat[up_order, ]


# get clustered matrix for 368 downreg genes
dn_hm = readRDS("data/heatmap_dn_368.rds")
dn_mat = dn_hm@ht_list[["log2fold"]]@matrix
dn_order = ComplexHeatmap::row_order(dn_hm)
dn_mat_ordered = dn_mat[dn_order, ]



# pull tables

out = list()

for(l in c("up_mat_ordered", "dn_mat_ordered")){
  
  m = get(l)
  
  name = paste0(nrow(m), "_", l)
  
  # relabel columns
  df = m %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Gene) %>%
    mutate(
      name = case_when(
        
        str_detect(name, "WT naive") ~ 
          gsub("WT naive", "wt", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "sham naive") ~ 
          gsub("sham naive", "sham", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "TAK1KO naive") ~ 
          gsub("TAK1KO naive", "ko", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "TAK1KO lipid") ~ 
          gsub("TAK1KO lipid", "lipid", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "TAK1KO TAK1-smRNA") ~ 
          gsub("TAK1KO TAK1-smRNA", "nat", name),
        
        str_detect(name, "TAK1KO mTAK1-smRNA") ~ 
          gsub("TAK1KO mTAK1-smRNA", "D175A", name)
        
      )
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "value")
  
  out[[name]] <- df
}

write_xlsx(out, "table1-1304-sig-genes.xlsx")

cleanup_objects()
```
